title: fix(ltb-r12-002): close G1-G4 in the R12 converter, refuse in-place conversion, carry custom linetypes
intent: Closes four measured gaps in the R12 converter landed by #381, each reproduced red against 22e6768 before its fix. G1: an elevated LWPOLYLINE raised TypeError inside add_polyline2d and reached /api/dxf/preflight/auto_fix callers as an unhandled HTTP 500. G2: reserved layer 0 / style Standard were skipped as already_present, so a source that customised them converted with the target's defaults. G3: convert_file wrote the destination and verified afterwards, so a failed verification left the caller's file overwritten. G4: TEXT's default style was missed after a round trip. D5: convert_file(p, p) now refuses (OutputPathError) instead of destroying the source; custom linetypes are carried by name and pattern instead of refused (422 -> 200), with _undefined_references extended to linetypes so the verifier, not the old refusal, guarantees no dangling reference. The verification half of r12_convert.py moves to r12_verify.py to hold both modules under the 500-line file-size ratchet; r12_convert re-exports every public name.

diff_articulation.what_changed: r12_convert: elevation carried as a point (_as_elevation_vec) and LWPOLYLINE vertex_z aligned with POLYLINE (G1); _carry updates reserved entries instead of skipping them (G2); publish_converted_document saves to a .tmp, verifies, then renames, unlinking the .tmp on failure, and is shared by convert_file and the endpoint (G3); TEXT style read from the entity including its default (G4); same_path guard (D5.1); _carry_linetypes carries custom linetypes with the simplified pattern re-encoded to linetypes.add's [total, dash, -gap] form (D5.2). r12_verify: the unchanged verification half, plus linetypes in _undefined_references. Router: calls publish_converted_document instead of saveas + verify_saved_file.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: G1 is a live HTTP 500 on a route two clients forward user files to. G3 is data loss on a failed verification. The existing suite passed with all four gaps present; each new test was run red against 22e6768 or against a mutant before its fix.
